verdict.rationale: Reconciliation reporting is a fair axis for a payment processor like Kushki, but the evidence pack covers only payment acceptance, refunds and voids, 3DS, tokens, recurring charges, and POS. Nothing documents settlement reports, bank-deposit reconciliation, or itemized fee, refund, and chargeback reporting. The refund-processing docs describe an adjacent feature, not reconciliation reports.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can reconcile settlements to bank deposits with itemized reports covering fees, refunds, and chargebacks
